dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge exhibiting a non-linear spline with a high degree of falcation transitioning from a broad posterior base to a narrow sub-apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Blunted/rounded apex with a small irregular notch or missing tissue fragment at the highest pixel coordinate.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin with a slight convex curvature at the basal attachment, maintaining an approximate 50-degree slope relative to the visible horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: High horizontal-to-vertical ratio, with the base width approximately 1.75 times the maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple small V-shaped and U-shaped notches along the trailing edge; distinct focal indentation at the apex; minor irregular serration at the lower anterior margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Mottled and patchy grey-scale pigmentation across the lateral surface of the fin, characterized by non-uniform pixel intensity clusters.
